ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 45% of the surface, predominantly on the distal lobes; low-intensity dark pixels occupy approximately 55%, concentrated in the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs on the lateral halves of both lobes. A central, broad dark region extends from the peduncle connection to the trailing edge. Extensive mottling and pixel fragmentation occur at the 1/3 and 2/3 lateral positions where dark and white regions meet.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad, obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 120 degrees and a relatively shallow depth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serration. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits irregular, high-amplitude indentations and a more jagged profile, particularly toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips with slight upward-oriented convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, dark, roughly circular pixels are visible on the distal white region of the right lobe and along the leading edge margins, consistent with focal scarring sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal dark lines across the distal white section of the left lobe and multiple faint, vertical linear disruptions across the central dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel vertical rake marks (light-on-dark contrast) in the central fluke region near the notch; irregular notched trauma on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a localized yellowish-brown pigmentation patch on the distal white surface of the right lobe.
